Get [Compensator](item_2a354f80-610c-4661-9bdd-8960ae1a60b0), [Weapon Grease](item_961ae72f-434f-406b-a89b-ab8efec806bf) & [Armored Vest](item_358361e2-59be-4c81-b221-8a87f37809e6) for Round 1.\

## 📌 ⟢ Round Notes !
**🔴 UNDER 34.5K 🔴**\
Prioritise [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) first if you didn't have that in Round 3, then [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb) if you have enough.\
If you can afford it, buy [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) **OR** [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) for survivability.\
These three items alone should be enough to keep you and your team up (assuming your other support is also healing) enough where everyone won't fall over too quickly.
- If you haven't fully pivoted to [Ability Power](stat_ability_power), **DO SO NOW** !!

**🟢 OVER 34.5k 🟢**\
If you need more survivability, [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) is a good **Survivability** item and synergises well with [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5).\
If you like more [Ability Power](stat_ability_power), consider getting [Nano Cola](item_79b22609-8046-4a8a-a5a2-bb49cd7e11c6).\
If you're filthy rich, consider [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8):
- This is arguably one of [Mercy](hero_0e213bfc-3ca9-49c6-9036-e7f344b752da)'s **BEST** survivability items, synergising well with [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5) & [The Whambulance](item_67e91029-d0fc-4c9d-9733-ec7e1cc064a9) as you will **constantly** be healing yourself everytime you GA or Resurrect an ally.

## 📌 ⟢ Round Notes !
**🔴 UNDER 43K 🔴**\
Prioritise [Angelic Acrobatics](item_baad85fc-3da5-43af-ad9d-f17885f59aa5), then [Mark of the Kitsune](item_09a53e39-25aa-4f66-ba51-bedbc543a1eb), then [Lumerico Fusion Drive](item_3da81000-333c-460a-a1a2-09441bfda9c8) as these are essentially the **MAIN CORE** items of the build.\
Feel free to buy any other filler items that fit within your budget, as long as you're either building **Survivability**, [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) or [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction).
- [Ironclad Exhaust Ports](item_2d085fa5-ace6-4fab-9323-b7a06268bcd0) **OR** [Vital-E-Tee](item_b92e6f1d-3aac-4eec-b027-00c8e1529016) for **Survivability**

**🟢 OVER 43k 🟢**\
I recommend getting [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b) as this is the next item we will be getting in the next round.\
If you need more survivability, consider getting [Martian Mender](item_0099632b-4e18-450e-844f-22c40e51bc98), [Blessed Boosters](item_957fd380-b7b4-40d4-8333-bb8c535ca931) **OR** [Nebula Conduit](item_476b7040-54c9-4f0c-8283-b4407f6809f8).\

**🔴 UNDER 52K 🔴**\
Prioritise the previous Epic items first, then if you can't afford [Superflexor](item_580b77b4-0d63-469b-99a8-5372c55dfc1b) even after selling all of your blues and greens, consider getting [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) items like [Multi-Tool](item_5ba8d94e-f2f3-44b7-8773-025fc6ed7c56), [Nano Cola](item_79b22609-8046-4a8a-a5a2-bb49cd7e11c6), [Long Distance Wings](item_8b4bafad-c8bc-4c77-bbe7-798b03920c88) & [Custom Stock](item_17d633af-8bcc-4893-b865-be0a7bc66fe2).\

- [Iridescent Iris](item_b7fb28ef-ce82-416b-8693-01c274f8df4e) for more [Ability Power](stat_ability_power) & [Cooldown Reduction](stat_cooldown_reduction)
